text: Literally the perfect habit app, extremely customizable and and reasonably priced with lifetime purchase option. Everything is very aesthetically pleasing with the unfortunate exception of the logo of the app itself and the similar "done" button in the app. I also personally would prefer an icon library over the use of emojis as icons. The text icon option is nice, but I find that chinese characters and some unicode symbols look like they are placed too low down in the box.
author: Rachelle Willemsma
developer_reply: Thank you for your feedback! We have recorded your issue. In the future, we will add more icon library features. Regarding the logo of the application itself and similar "Done" buttons within the application, we will continue to optimize and provide more options for selection and customization.
